text:
- Locate target cup and plate first. If instruction names an arm, use it; otherwise choose arm on cup side (x<0 left, x>0 right).
- Grasp cup body centre top-down; avoid rim unless body fails. If UNREACHABLE, try other arm once; if still UNREACHABLE, home the non-grasping arm and retry body centre.
- If NOT_SEEN/EMPTY_GRASP, re-locate using the instruction description; do not switch to another similar object.
- Call place(arm, cup, plate, "on"); it moves to plate top and releases. No extra lift/release/home unless place fails.
- Before done, verify on(cup, plate), released(arm), cup center over plate footprint, gripper open, and cup upright/stable; ignore exact bottom height or few-cm centering.
goal: Cup rests upright and stable on the gray plate, centered over its footprint, with the grasping arm released.
